instruction:
You are tasked with designing a module that will send messages via an RC switch. The module should have the following inputs:

- clk: a clock signal
- rst: a reset signal
- send: a signal that indicates when a new message should be sent
- addr: a 40-bit signal containing the address of the switch
- chan: a 40-bit signal containing the channel of the switch
- stat: a 16-bit signal containing the status of the switch

The module should have the following outputs:

- ready: a signal that indicates when the module is ready to send a new message
- out: a signal that contains the bits of the message being sent

The module should behave as follows:

- When the send signal is high, the module should start sending a new message.
- The message should be 128 bits long and should contain the address, channel, status, and a fixed 32-bit value (10000000_00000000_00000000_00000000).
- The module should shift out the bits of the message one at a time on the out signal.
- When the message is complete, the module should set the ready signal high and wait for the send signal to go high again before sending another message.
